title: Effectivity of the fixed open reduction mate and reconstruction unit
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E/Q_l. Use the actual reduction/total-limit adjunction [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus] and any section-normalized RealizationModel for the actual strict-system operations [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge, def-sf-integral-system-operations]. Let j:X→Y be a quasi-compact open immersion. Let K be a finite-Tor bounded constructible derived-complete integral complex [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], or the canonical integral tensor unit. Then the component at K of RealizationModel.openReduction, the inverse open-adjunction mate of the fixed reductionPull isomorphism, is invertible. The actual reconstruction unit at ordinary completed-ring extension by zero j_!K is invertible as well. No choice of a replacement realization model is made. The assertion includes the identity open and the empty open.

source.place: Maps-used sentence, primitive tensor/pullback coefficient comparison and open-factor normalization.

proof.text: The ordinary open quotient mate is invertible. For each good representative, the localization formula conjugates the specified derived mate to Q of that degreewise invertible ordinary mate. Good-representative localization is essentially surjective, so naturality transports invertibility to every derived object.

Finite-Tor constructibility implies derived completeness, using the intrinsic/legacy comparison. For the coefficient unit, the native K-flat tensor comparison identifies its unit with the completed regular module in degree zero; the latter is derived complete. Completeness transports across this isomorphism.

Choose the existing projection-normalized DVR coefficient and open models for the coefficient uniformizer. Apply the intrinsic criterion to the input, quasi-compact open transport, and the intrinsic criterion in reverse. Identify the DVR extension with ringedOpen, transport completeness along that isomorphism, and apply the actual-unit criterion for the existing DVR completion model.

proof_origin.place: Open-factor normalization. W9: ordinary whole-system mate, its good-representative localization, and the existing DVR intrinsic completeness and actual-unit criteria.

theorem openReconstructionEffectivity (system : IntegralSystemRealization.Operations l E)
    (realization : IntegralSystemRealization.RealizationModel l E system) {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : X ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X))
    (_hK : finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E X K ∨
      K = (IntegralSystemRealization.calculus l E X).integralClosed.monoidal.tensorUnit) :
    IsIso ((realization.openReduction l E j).app K) ∧
      IsIso ((IntegralSystemRealization.calculus l E Y).adjunction.unit.app
        ((IntegralSystemRealization.ringedOpen l E j).obj K))
